name: (test) Snezhnaya Sumpter Beast
desc: A four-legged animal with white fur that is a distant relative of the Sumeru Sumpter Beast.\nWhite Sumpter Beasts are docile and affectionate, and possess a natural resistance to the cold. In the past, they were the most important means of transportation across the snow plains. Even today, they remain great helpers for Snezhnayan traveling merchants.
